title: The Three Green Twigs

full_text:
A holy hermit lived in a lonely mountain cave, spending his days in fasting and prayer. Over the years, pride crept into his heart, until he believed himself purer and more righteous than all other mortals.

One day, he saw a criminal being led to the gallows and muttered in self-righteous contempt, "That wicked sinner deserves nothing but eternal destruction!"

That very night, an angel appeared to the hermit, handing him a dry, withered branch with three brittle twigs. "Take this dead wood," the angel commanded. "Carry it through the world, begging bread from door to door, and never sleep in a bed until three green leaves sprout from these dry twigs. By your harsh judgment, you closed your heart to divine mercy."

The hermit wept in bitter repentance. For decades, he wandered barefoot through storms and heat, sleeping on bare stones, asking for nothing but dry crusts, and comforting the sick and forgotten.

In his extreme old age, he gave his last crust of bread to a starving beggar and knelt beneath an ancient mountain pine to breathe his last prayer of humble remorse. When the morning sun shone upon his peaceful face, three radiant, emerald-green leaves had sprouted from the dry twigs, showing that a truly contrite heart is restored to grace by boundless love.
moral: Divine mercy is broader than human judgment; repentance sprouts green leaves from dry wood.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Three Green Twigs"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
